full_page.content:
1945, September 7
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N. Y.
September 7ª 1945
Dear Brother Leo:
God bless you and all in Detroit.
I am sending you back the relic you chose as also the little particles of Fr. Stephen's habit. They are pieces left over from about ten or more years ago, when Fr. Capistran was Guardian and we had the Felician Sisters mount those others, now I presume, about all gone. I think they would be glad to finish that work. Some of their numbers are quite enthusiastic about Fr. Stephen.
God Bless you. Praised be Jesus Christ! .Fr. Sol.
P.S. I think the Sisters could be easily induced to mount some of these relics a little more artistically than what I was satisfied ten years ago.
Praised be Jesus, Mary, Joseph!
